description: Runs chip/module1_target_v1.json for 87 days. Staggered seeding (day 0 neural, 40 glia, 45 astrocyte) so all three lineages mature together on day 80; CONTINUOUS perfusion throughout at 480 uL/cm2/day through each lane's own off-chip vented gas-exchange reservoir, with NO capped hold anywhere - attachment is perfused at a flow 779x below the velocity that could wash an unattached cell out. Each lane is a closed loop while it differentiates and the shared bus is capped, so the lanes are hydraulically separate, not merely flow-balanced. Day 80-86: one interaction direction at a time across the bus, each with a VEHICLE CONTROL arm (the same medium from a reservoir that never held cells, same route, same flow, same 6 h), selected by the chip's run_parameters.variant, with per-lane supernatant draws before and after every direction. Day 87: fields 1-2 of each lane are rinsed and quenched IN PLACE for metabolome and proteome while fields 3-6 of the same lane stay perfused and are handed to the cell-prep stage for the transcriptome. Every flow is computed from chamber geometry with mu = 0.0008 Pa s (fluid.viscosity_37c_pa_s, medium at 37 C - NOT the 0.001 Pa s dye-demo value for water at 20 C) and kept under the ceiling that belongs to the step: 0.01 dyn/cm2 for living adherent cells, 0.3 for the rinse before a deliberate quench. Steps are in calendar order, but the three lanes run CONCURRENTLY on independent loops, so the durations sum to more than the 87-day calendar; a serial player will stretch it. Reagent names are generic (CONFIDENTIALITY.md).

steps.note: Day -0.5. LANE (one lane on its own loop): Coat group 1 of the neural lane through p_n_in1 alone. One wetted volume (138 uL) so every field and both spines see the coating; the other two lanes are on their own loops and are not touched.

Day -0.5. LANE (one lane on its own loop): Coat group 2 of the neural lane through p_n_in2 alone. One wetted volume (275 uL) so every field and both spines see the coating; the other two lanes are on their own loops and are not touched.

Day 0. LANE (one lane on its own loop): Seed the neural lane's field 1: one field volume of suspension, delivered through p_n_in1 with the spine flow at 15 uL/min. That flow is set by sedimentation, not by habit: below about 15 uL/min cells settle in the spine before they reach the far field and the six fields seed unequally, which is the demo chip's seeding failure re-created at target scale. At 7.5 uL/min per field the wall shear is 0.0042 dyn/cm2, still under the 0.01 ceiling, and the cells are not attached yet.

Day 0.02. LANE (one lane on its own loop): ATTACHMENT, 24 h, PERFUSED at 0.17 uL/min - NOT a capped hold. A sealed field holds about 211 min of oxygen for its cells, so the demo's 'all ports capped, 24 h' starves them for two thirds of every day; this is the single change that fixes audit finding 2. At this flow U = 0.00029 mm/s against the 0.229 mm/s a cell needs to be carried out, a factor of 779, so unattached cells cannot be washed away either.
